title: Senior Consultant
ai_disclaimer: We use Greenhouse’s AI-powered Talent Matching tool to compare your application against our job requirements.

questions.label: This role requires an average of 25% travel to client sites outside of your local geography. Are you able to meet this requirement?
Are you able to work onsite at a client location within your local area up to 100% of the time, depending on the engagement?
Have you reviewed the base plus bonus compensation range in the job posting for the position you applied for?
Are you authorized to work lawfully in the United States for The Gunter Group?
If you currently have work authorization based on a visa, what type of visa do you hold? If not applicable, please enter N/A.

Will you now or in the future require The Gunter Group to commence (“sponsor”) an immigration case in order to employ you (for example, H-1B or other employment-based immigration case)? This is sometimes called “sponsorship” for an employment-based visa status.
How did you hear about this job?

We don’t require a traditional cover letter, though feel free to include one if you’d like. Instead, we ask a few short questions to better understand your interests, experience, and how you approach your work.

Why do you want to continue your career in consulting, and how does this role at TGG fit into what you’re looking for next?
At TGG, our Non-Negotiables define how we approach our work and one another. Which of our Non‑negotiables shows up most in how you work? Share a brief example.
Tell us about a recent project or piece of work you’re proud of that you believe aligns with one or more of TGG’s service areas. What did you contribute, and what made it a success?
